text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: That's it for the Kikuka Sho...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: And... I lost.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Trainer? I...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I will win the next one.

Biwa Hayahide put everything on the<n>line for the
Kikuka Sho. But now that<n>it's over, things feel a
little different<n>than usual.
As soon as we get back to the<n>academy...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hiii! Hey, Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, we didn't really get a chance<n>to talk after the
concert, so I brought<n>Taishin with me!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I gotta say, you looked a lot scarier<n>out there today
than you ever have. I<n>mean, like... seriously scary.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ticket...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But I'm gonna keep getting better<n>and better, so
you'd better watch out<n>for me! Yeeeaaah! Woo!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Does she ever think about anyone<n>other than
herself?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I do understand what she<n>means. It was
like we finally saw<n>your full abilities out there today.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Anyway, have you decided on your<n>next race yet?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Good question. Well, since we<n>finished all the
Classic Triple Crown<n>races, the next one available
after<n>winter is...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. It's a prestigious race in<n>Kyoto, and I really
want to compete<n>with elite racers there.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'll have to win it if I want to be called<n>the best of
my generation.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Good luck with that. I'll be there too.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: And I'll be there to win. Later.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I guess Taishin has a selfish side to<n>her too.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But it's natural that she'd want to<n>win. Hehe, I'm
just glad to have<n>finally caught up to Taishin and
Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You heard them, Trainer! We'd better<n>go at this
next one with the same<n>energy!

It's an utter relief seeing how much<n>brighter her
smile is than before.
